dependencies.finding: A physical-size framebuffer does not remove 240-wide logical pixel expansion. Native-sized primitives, text, icons and coordinates must be coherent.

Quick uses 240-wide raster rows and logical height >=240. Adapter bounds are 160..1024 on both physical axes and the native-height path rejects logical height <240. 480×320 derives logical 240×160 and fails full-app opening even if the new Springboard renderer alone handles it.

Preserve padded native strides, minimum sizes, overflow checks, single submit token, cancellation and retained/uncertain-provider ownership. Native layout does not authorize simplifying service/lifecycle rules.

Native capability geometry is present in the reviewed host, but exact shipped host/profile/text-input closure and bitmap font quality need qualification. Reviewed host bounds are 160..2048; font scale 1..4 and fixed glyph bitmaps remain.
Viewer canvas is capability-sized within 160..1200 bounds; rotation and monochrome working/snapshot copies do not imply reduced-resolution scaling. Verify kind==CANVAS_VIEWER and exact .43 build.
Frozen font/icon atlases and 5×7 bitmap expansion need independent review. Springboard-only native font work does not migrate other apps or shared Quick assets.

Recover/bind exact package source + dependencies + defines + normalization/compaction against .43 hashes before migration. Older retained-50 receipts are source lineage, not proof of this product payload when hashes differ.

scope_limits: Source review demonstrates implementation structure, not target execution.
All full-app native rendering qualification flags remain false unless a separate final report supplies evidence.
No device-specific shared application branches are proposed.
Any capability size requires checked resource/ABI limits and explicit handling outside the supported envelope, not a universal allocation promise.
